Ergenverse Modpack

A living cultivation-world simulator reconstructing the Er Gen multiverse (Renegade Immortal / 兮逆).

Requirements

  • Minecraft: 1.20.1
  • Forge: 47.4.0
  • Java: 17

Included Mods

Ergenverse
Version 0.1.5-alpha · by stohco · MIT License
Bundled JAR: overrides/mods/ergenverse-0.1.5-alpha.jar

Installation

  1. Open the CurseForge app
  2. Click + Create Custom Profile
  3. Click Import and select this ZIP file
  4. Launch the profile — Forge 47.4.0 and Minecraft 1.20.1 will be installed automatically
  5. On first launch, world generation takes ~60 seconds (custom biomes, NPC village, spirit herbs). Be patient.

What to Expect

Spawn into a forested biome on Planet Suzaku. The world already exists: birds flock between trees, spirit butterflies drift around herbs, wolves avoid one valley, fish flee something unseen, distant roars echo from mountains. Find the Wang Family Village to observe NPCs living their lives — Wang Lin meditates, wolves stalk the perimeter, villagers flee or guard based on their personalities.
